hooks.name: Public repo check before commit
hooks.description: Before a shell command runs: if it is git commit, check what is staged and block when an added line has an em or en dash (Boo's voice), a file is an env or key file, a line looks like an API key, or a line holds a home folder path. Any other command passes at once. Runs node tools/public-repo-check.mjs --hook; the same check runs in .githooks/pre-commit.
